strategies.why: This search will find simple, unassigned issues that are labeled as 'good first issue' and were created after January 1, 2025, making them suitable for quick fixes.

This search will find issues that are labeled as 'help wanted' with a body that includes the phrase 'help wanted', have no assignee, and have fewer than 5 comments, making them ideal for proposing a tool or small utility.
This broad search will find issues labeled as 'good first issue' that are open, providing a wide range of opportunities to contribute documentation or minor improvements.

issues.body:
### Context

Mock server: pick the example by query string or header
issues.body:
The mock server (`wails/internal/mock`) answers each route with the request's default example. It would be useful to choose between examples by a condition, e.g. `?status=error` or header `X-Mock-Example: not-found`, so one route can return success and error cases.

Sketch: an optional `match` on each example (`{ query: {k: v}, headers: {k: v} }`), the first matching example wins, the default stay

issues.title: Flatpak / Flathub package
issues.body:
Zeno ships `.deb`, `.rpm` and AppImage, and there are manifests for AUR, Homebrew, Scoop and winget in `packaging/`. A Flathub package would make it one click away on most distros.

issues.title: Interface in English (i18n)
issues.body:
The app UI is Portuguese only. An English UI (and a way to add more languages) would open Zeno to many more users.

Ideas:
- a small dictionary per language in `src/renderer/src/i18n/` and a `t('key')` helper; language from the OS with an override in *Preferences*
- start with the most visible screens (sidebar, request/response panes, workspace screen, import) and migrate the rest gradually
- Go-s

issues.title: Widgets are still using dynamic colors when dynamic theme is off
issues.body: I don't remember if I intentionally did this to make it fit with the home screen, but if I disable dynamic color in the theme settings, then I would expect the widgets to not be dynamically colored or at least there to be a separate setting to control whether dynamic colors still apply to the widgets.
